steps.name: Grani
steps.text: We're in the clear!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: You okay, Big Bob—

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Huh? That wound on your leg...

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: There are some stragglers over there! They're probably from the Valk Vanguards!

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: I can handle this on my own! Go after the ones who are fleeing!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: This kid...

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Hey, hey, why are you giving me that look?

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: G-get away from me or I'll put a hole through you!

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: You took care of them all?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Impressive. This kid's got talent.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Stay there and don't move. I'll patch you up.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: It's fine, I can take care of myself.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: No means no.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: You saw it, right?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: You saw the crystalization on my body, right? Are you trying to get yourself infected?!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Our mission at Rhodes Island is to help all the Infected.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Rhodes Island? Aren't you from Victoria...?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Former Victoria Mounted Police. Now, I'm a Rhodes Island operator!

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Stay back, lass. I'm an Infected.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Miss Carol, this might get a bit messy. You should step back a bit.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: All right, I stopped the bleeding.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: You do this a lot, huh? For the Infected?

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: You're not afraid of me...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: A lot of my coworkers are already Infected, but I can't tell who is and who isn't.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Well, it's sometimes hard to tell until it's time to hit the showers, right?

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: ...Hmph.

steps.name: Big Bob
steps.text: Thanks, shorty. You're naive, but you're a good person.
